title: Temporal observability of intraoperative hypotension with an emulated 5-minute blood pressure display: reproducibility package
description: Code, configuration template, reproducibility manifests, figure source data, editable vector figures, final workbook and non-identifiable aggregate outputs for a retrospective waveform study of intermittent blood pressure display. Version 1.4.0 adds new versus inherited low-value classification, case and phase distributions, event robustness, interval summaries, recorded vasopressor infusion-adjustment analyses and a corrected cuff-record audit. Raw VitalDB, MoVeR and INSPIRE datasets and patient-level derivatives are not redistributed. The archived emulation describes monitoring information on fixed recorded arterial trajectories; it does not estimate treatment delay or monitoring-related outcome benefit.
